CustomField.description: Lookup to a Form_Template_Page_Section__c assigned to this page as 'Section 15' — the highest of the 15 numbered section-assignment slots. The formTemplatePageSection LWC maps the slot name 'Section 15' to this lookup (PAGE_SECTION_FIELD_MAP) to resolve and render the assigned section component on the record-page builder. Reaching this slot means the page is at its 15-section cap (#168); component-visibility rules max out at 10 filters, so the 15 lookups are also collapsed into the Has Assigned Sections formula. Managed by the page section configurator — assign and reorder sections there rather than editing these lookups directly. Delete constraint Set Null.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This holds the section component placed in slot 15, the last available slot on a page; the page section configurator sets and reorders these slots for you. A page caps at 15 numbered section slots (Section 1 to Section 15) — if you need more, split the content across additional pages rather than editing these lookups by hand.
CustomField.label: Form Component Section (15)
